items.title: 22.2 Key statistical measures and their calculation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of key statistical measures (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Bunyadi statistical paimane data ka khulasa karte aur us ka markazi rujhan, farq aur taqseem dikhate hain. Mean ausat qeemat, median darmiyani nuqta aur mode sab se zyada aane wali qeemat hai; standard deviation aur range phailao naapte hain; aur percentiles gehre tajziye ke liye data ko hisson mein baant'te hain.

blocks.title: Formulas saada alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Mean = qeematon ka jama / qeematon ki tadaad. Grouped mean = (frequency x midpoint) ka jama / frequencies ka jama. Range = sab se bari qeemat - sab se chhoti. Percentile rank R = (P / 100) x (n + 1). Standard deviation = [(qeemat - mean) ke murabbon ka jama / qeematon ki tadaad] ka jazr.

blocks.prompt: Kaun se paimane data ka markaz aur kaun se phailao batate hain?
blocks.explanation: Markaz: mean, median aur mode. Phailao: standard deviation aur range (percentiles taqseem dikhate hain).

items: Phailao: standard deviation, range; percentiles taqseem ko baant'te.
